_comment: Machine-checkable thesis registry. The prose lives in open-theses.md; this is the part a script can score. Every thesis needs an invalidation condition expressed as a CHECK a script can evaluate. A thesis whose invalidation cannot be mechanised is a thesis whose invalidation will never actually be checked.

_check_types.below_sma: closes below the named SMA (50 or 200)
_check_types.date_passed: catalyst date passed without the catalyst
_check_types.manual: requires human judgement — script flags for review, does not decide

theses.thesis: The private bank that works while HDFC Bank falls. Uptrend, RSI 54, 91st percentile, revision diffusion +0.75, target +20%.

invalidation.note: Q2 FY27 NIM compression alongside slowing advances; or the CEO reappointment thread escalates to an RBI action

theses.notes: Capped 2026-08-27 on governance: six GST notices >Rs1,350cr in six months, CEO reappointment contested to RBI, escalated 24 Aug.

theses.thesis: Cheapest large exposure to the credit cycle. 11.5x P/E, 1.56x book, 15.4% RoE. PSU banks outpacing private in this cycle.

invalidation.note: system credit growth decelerating below ~12%, or a corporate slippage cycle

theses.thesis: EMS at 100% breadth, +27.9% over three months, Rs1.9 lakh crore policy push behind it.

invalidation.note: loss of a major customer programme; margin below ~3%; or a China input restriction after 10 Nov

theses.notes: Capped THREE times: memory BOM shock, Mobile PLI 2.0 disbursed nothing, and the moat IS the China dependency. Half position, no adds.

theses.thesis: 91 GW to ~150 GW by FY32, regulated ~15% RoE compounding book value with a 2.65% yield. Electricity demand is a multi-decade certainty.

invalidation.note: regulated RoE framework changed; or the CBI Ramagundam FIR names NTPC personnel formally; or the CMD vacancy persists past Jan 2027

theses.notes: Decades horizon — no stop. Trend is negative and the sector has 20% breadth; that is an entry consideration, not an invalidation.

theses.thesis: Sum-of-parts: Jio alone is valued at $130-180bn against a ~$186bn market cap. The listing forces the market to price the parts.

invalidation.note: Jio IPO does not list by year-end
the promoter reverses course and sells; or the FY+1 EPS cuts continue past two more quarters

theses.notes: TENSION UNRESOLVED: promoter bought ~Rs9,000cr in July while FY+1 EPS was cut 5.23% in 30 days.

theses.thesis: Pure event trade on the Jio listing lifting telecom index weight 4-5% to 7-8% and clearing the way for tariff hikes.
theses.notes: Downgraded 2026-08-27. Jio stalled at SEBI: no observation letter, no price band, no date. Mittal+Singtel sold >$4bn across 2025. Closed below 50 DMA.

theses.thesis: India capex proxy. Verified 2026-08-27: the capex cycle IS real for large capital-intensive corporates above ~75% utilisation, and L&T-type names are the correct expression.

invalidation.note: revision breadth deteriorates further from the current -0.29
Indian order inflow share of the book keeps falling versus European

theses.notes: Benched on contract mix (European offshore wind, not Indian NIP) and 5 up / 9 down revision breadth — NOT on the thesis, which verified.

theses.thesis: 14.9x, 4.2% yield, RoE 31.9%, AI already 8.2% of revenue, positioning emptied out with FII IT holdings at a 4-year low.

invalidation.note: ENTRY signal, not exit — buy when revision breadth turns positive
a guidance RAISE. Also now: H-1B rule finalisation or HIRE Act revival

theses.notes: 4 up / 30 down. Entry is a guidance raise, never a cheap multiple. Now also carries US trade-policy risk I had framed purely as AI risk.

closed.reason: Governance: MSRDC Rs45cr differential-interest payment, RBI query into the board's own Rs1 lakh penalty on its CEO, US securities class action. Three consecutive 52-week lows.
closed.lesson: The governance screen never ran because it hit a concurrency cap and I never re-queued it.

closed.reason: 199 forged Tejas supplier test certificates found by HAL's own audit, a fatal crash, a fleet grounding, zero Mk-1A delivered, MoD weighing penalties.
closed.lesson: I bought trend plus a budget number and never asked whether the flagship programme delivers.

closed.reason: Oil and gas had 0% of members above their 200 DMA; Brent was 27% below its high with the EIA modelling $69 for 2027.
closed.lesson: Anchored on a spot price without checking its trend. The driver was already reversing when I wrote the thesis. And the windfall levy — my stated invalidation — had already been reintroduced in March 2026.
